routes.title: About CLMI
text: In 1987 the Lord opened the door for Bishop Elizabeth Arowolo and her husband Professor O. O. Arowolo to start Christ's Love Ministries International in Badagry, Nigeria with many branches. The Lord laid a strong burden on their hearts to preach the gospel with great signs and wonders, as well as to be engaged in church planting all over the world. The back bone of the mission is supplication, intercession and spiritual warfare, for the body of Christ and for all nations.

In the year 1993, Christ's Love Ministries International was started in Namibia. The missionary work in Namibia started in Windhoek, the capital city of the nation, and has since spread to several regions in the country as well as to Angola and Zimbabwe. Currently there are several churches of Christ’s Love Ministries International in Namibia as well as several online members all over the globe. To God be all the glory, AMEN
Christlike faith, love, truth, holiness and righteousness for all nations 1 timothy 1:5

As we receive the love and mercy of God, we lift up the name of Jesus Christ in powerful spiritual warfare and intercession wherever and whenever the Holy Spirit leads us. we plant churches, teach and demonstrate the love of Jesus Christ that passes all understanding that all might accept Jesus Christ as their personal Lord and Saviour, and as their all in all. God bless you as you continue to fellowship with us. Ephesians 3:14-19

Whether your family is visiting for the first time or looking for a church community where children can flourish in faith, we would love to welcome you and answer your questions.

routes.title: 23rd Annual Convention · 2024
text: The 23rd Annual Convention held from June 21st to 23rd, 2024, at Christ's Love Ministries International was nothing short of an extraordinary blessing. People from all corners of the globe gathered in faith, anticipation, and hope, and the atmosphere was filled with the power of healing, renewal, and divine transformation.

Over the three days, attendees experienced life-altering moments—healing, breakthroughs, and countless blessings. It was truly a time of restoration, as God’s presence moved mightily, touching hearts and lives in ways words can scarcely describe.

The convention brought together believers from all nations, united in the spirit, to receive God's Word and anointing in abundance. Powerful teachings, inspiring worship, and anointed prayers uplifted everyone in attendance, leaving us all with a renewed sense of purpose and faith.

For those who were able to attend, this event will be remembered for years to come as a highlight in their spiritual journey. And for those who missed it—don’t worry, next year’s Annual Convention promises to be even more extraordinary. You won’t want to miss it!

Mark your calendars, invite your family and friends, and prepare for an unforgettable experience. The next convention will be a time of deeper healing, greater blessings, and a move of God like never before. Stay tuned, and get ready to witness what God has in store for His people in the year ahead!
